quote: The performance of the models trained on our dataset was evaluated using several metrics. For classification models, we employed accuracy, adjacent accuracy, and macro-F1 score... For regression models, performance was assessed using mean squared error (MSE).

We evaluated the zero-shot capability of generative LLMs to identify difficult words and structures... we prompt the model using the full text, the associated global readability level, and a list of target words. The model is then prompted to assess which of the target words are likely to present difficulty... For the binary setup, GPT-4.1 consistently outperforms the other models...

We then conducted an annotation campaign... carried out by 15 professionals active in the field of illiteracy... Each text was annotated by at least three annotators... For the local annotation, annotators followed the guidelines to highlight specific words or expressions that could pose difficulties...
guideline: Annotators defined nine difficulty classes covering lexical, syntactic, semantic, and structural sources of complexity including: Difficult or unknown word, Spelling or decoding problem, Figure of speech, Difficult cultural reference, Grammar-related difficulty, etc.
